_comment: WHI-1555 (R021-P09) cycle-safe SOR selection records, checked by tests/routing/test_cycle_safe_sor_contract.py. Core fixtures are hand-built (route, percent) quote tables whose expected selections were traced by hand through the B-S rules (cycle-safe-sor.md section 6); adapter fixtures are synthetic constant-product bundles whose expected outputs come from the hand integer getAmountOut formula in the test, never from the selector under test. corpus_probe is a pinned summary of the bounded diagnostic pass of section 9 (tuning split plus the known report-split defect cases as regressions only).

K1_three_route_cycle.note: pairwise-acyclic routes whose three-route union a->b->c->a is a cycle; admission must test the whole union

K2_tie_continue_scan.note: r2 and r3 tie at 50; r2 precedes r3 in B-Q1 order but closes x->y->x with r1, so the scan continues to r3; equal final amounts reverse under B-F1

K4_acyclic_reference_but_different_resul.note: the reference's final selection is acyclic, yet its cyclic partial node r1+r2 displaced r1+r3, which the variant keeps and completes; zero rejections is the exact condition for trajectory equality, not an acyclic reference result

K5_pruning_regression.note: the reference's cyclic two-route best keeps the B-S5 pruning rule open and it reaches a valid three-route selection; the variant's best stays the one-route baseline, so pruning stops it at splits = 3: no dominance over the reference

K6_no_admissible_selection.note: no 100 % entry; the only complete selection is the cyclic pair

A1_union_cycle.note: individually simple, physical-pool-disjoint routes s-x-y-t (a,b,c) and s-y-x-t (d,e,f) whose union closes x->y->x; b and e price x/y in opposite directions (a cyclic-arbitrage loop the v1 set forbids)

expected_port.error: economic token cycle: x -> y -> x

A3_no_admissible_overflow.note: Merchant Moe Classic sourced pools near uint112: the first hops a/d revert at 100 %, and the second-hop pools c/f revert on every 50 % entry except the two 3-hop routes, whose union is cyclic

expected_port.error: economic token cycle: x -> y -> x

A4_replay_budget.note: two equal direct pools, 100001 at 50/50: the 4-entry table fits max_quotes 4, the D-1 ALL_REMAINING leg (50001) needs a fifth quote during replay

A6_all_entries_null.note: one Moe Classic pool whose s reserve is 10 below uint112: every grid entry reverts, the selector runs on an empty table and returns no selection (a completed zero-rejection trajectory with nothing to replay)

A7_replay_invalid.note: 101 at 50/50 over a shallow pool p1 and a Moe pool p2 50 below uint112: p2@50 (50) fits, p2@100 reverts; the split p2@50 + p1@50 = 49 + 33 beats p1@100 = 50; B-F1 reverses the equal amounts so p2 is last and D-1 gives it 51, which reverts in the replay: a completed selector (zero rejections) with a completed invalid_plan replay

A5_phase_semantics.note: memo section 4.7: which solves are completed, comparable selector trajectories; early cuts and enumeration statuses never count as reference identity; a replay cut keeps a completed identical selector but is not end-to-end comparable; CS-2 publication differences stay visible. Expected values follow from the phase rules and the hand fixtures, not from the code under test

options.validator: accepts exactly the empty mapping; every key, reserved or not, is refused

corpus_probe.pass: bounded diagnostic of cycle-safe-sor.md section 9.4: one in-process solve per case in which the reference selector runs on the identical quote table; process pool of 6 on a shared host; not a measured solve, no timing recorded
corpus_probe.command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run python tests/routing/test_cycle_safe_sor_contract.py probe <bundle> <out.json> [case ids...]

parts.name: tuning
parts.use: registered exploration matched_sor_cycle_safe on the tuning split (all 96 cases); nothing tuned

parts.name: report_defect_regressions
parts.use: the 12 known WHI-1447 uni_sor_port invalid_plan cases only, as defect regressions: not tuning data, not a quality comparison

corpus_probe_enriched.view: current memo section 4.7 phase view; produced by re-running the same probe on the same cases with the phase-aware spec_solve (selector, table, candidate and order behaviour unchanged). Numeric and selection fields are identical to the historical corpus_probe (checked per case by historical_fields_sha256); only the phase fields are new. corpus_probe itself stays the verbatim c9c6ca4 record.
